description: Free open-source Windows desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets (file organizing, sticky notes, todos, weather, system monitoring, and more)
notes: Upstream only ships an Inno Setup installer: scoop unpacks it automatically on install (innounp extracts the {app} program files) without running the installer, touching the registry, or requiring UAC; Start Menu/desktop shortcuts are created by scoop.

The app bundles the full WinAppSDK runtime (self-contained deployment), so there are no extra system dependencies; if shortcuts break after an upgrade, run scoop uninstall followed by install to recreate them.
